claims.head: Special teams lean toward the Rangers
claims.call: The Rangers’ power play creates at least their usual 8.3 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Rangers’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Capitals’ kill is near the bottom of the league. The Capitals need to stay out of the box.
claims.nums: NY Rangers 5th for power play (8.3 expected goals per 60) · Washington 27th for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Rangers’ power play has a soft target in the Capitals’ kill.

claims.head: The Rangers feed on mistakes, and the Capitals make them
claims.call: The Rangers get at least their usual 7.6% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
claims.body: The Rangers turn stolen pucks into chances, and the Capitals are the league’s worst at avoiding breakdowns. A sloppy pass or two could cost the Capitals.
claims.nums: NY Rangers 10th for chances off turnovers (7.6% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Washington 32nd for avoiding breakdowns
claims.gist: The Rangers pounce on loose pucks, and the Capitals cough them up.
